## Outcome
Describe the user-visible or system behavior to deliver in one or two sentences.

## Context and starting points
- Repository:
- Relevant files:
- Existing contract to preserve:

## In scope
- [ ] Implementation step one
- [ ] Implementation step two
- [ ] Documentation or binding updates

## Out of scope
State boundaries so the agent does not infer unrelated work.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable behavior or API contract
- [ ] Authorization and invalid-input behavior
- [ ] Compatibility with existing data and clients

## Verification
List exact commands or test scenarios. Report what ran and any environment limitation.

## Dependencies
Link prerequisite issues; state whether work can start before they close.

## Agent handoff
Open a pull request linked to this issue. In the PR, summarize the contract, files changed, tests run, migration/deployment effect, and any remaining decision. Follow repository instructions if present. Never use a destructive data reset as a migration shortcut.
